subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing checklist for Northbridge Therapeutics
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@northbridge.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing checklist for Northbridge Therapeutics

Hi Sofia — great to connect this morning. Quick recap and the few items we agreed would help us move the commercial process forward. I’ve pulled these into a short checklist for your procurement/billing team.

Summary from the call
- Use case: batch document extraction + resident-facing chat for scheduling — pilot target: 3 months.
- Expected monthly token volume (estimate): ~3M tokens/month.
- Desired go-live: July 1 (pilot).

Action items / asks for procurement & billing readiness
1) Purchase route: confirm whether you will issue a PO or prefer to pay by card. If PO, please share the PO template and payment instructions.
2) Net terms: confirm required net terms (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60).
3) Invoice requirements: billing address, VAT/tax ID, whether you need line-item pricing, and any special invoice format.
4) Vendor onboarding: any forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire); if you have a standard security questionnaire, please share.
5) Marketplace interest: do you have a preferred marketplace (AWS, Azure, GCP) or do you want Redwood to bill directly?

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft Redwood MSA and a short onboarding checklist for your legal/finance review (see attached: redwood_msa_draft.pdf).

Next steps
- Can you confirm items 1–4 by EOD Friday? If PO is the route, please send your template so we can align billing fields.
- I’ll loop finance and our onboarding lead as soon as we have the PO and invoice details.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood_msa_draft.pdf (PDF, 187 KB)
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@northbridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Billing checklist for Northbridge Therapeutics

Hi Alex — thanks for the recap and the MSA. Quick answers from procurement below. I’m copying our procurement inbox for the official templates.

1) Purchase route: We prefer to use PO for vendors of this scope. I attached our PO template for your team to review (nb_po_template.pdf).
2) Net terms: Standard for Northbridge is Net 30. We may request Net 45 for new vendors on pilot, but Net 30 is our starting point.
3) Invoice requirements:
   - Billing name: Northbridge Therapeutics, Inc.
   - Billing address: 425 Atlantic Ave, Suite 900, Boston, MA 02110
   - Tax ID/VAT: US EIN 22-3456789 (no VAT on US entity)
   - Please include PO number on the invoice and an itemized line for ‘inference usage’ (tokens) + any fixed fees.
4) Vendor onboarding: We require a completed vendor form and either a W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax document. We will also want evidence of SOC 2 Type II or similar security attestations.
5) Marketplace: We do not use a marketplace for procurement — direct billing to Redwood is preferred so we can use our PO.

We’ll review the MSA internally and circle back with any redlines. For now, please confirm you can accept Net 30 and invoice with PO number field.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Clinical Ops Programs
Northbridge Therapeutics
sofia.martinez@northbridge.com

Thanks for the flag, Alex — quick responses and next steps from onboarding/finance: 

- Invoice format: We can include a PO number field and an itemized breakdown: (1) inference usage (tokens), (2) fixed platform fee (if applicable), (3) credits/discounts. I’ll attach our onboarding checklist for procurement so they know which documents to expect.
- Terms: Finance confirms we can accept Net 30 for this pilot. If Northbridge requests Net 45, we can escalate to finance for review, but Net 30 is acceptable and preferred.
- Security docs: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II letter and a security questionnaire (I’ll send the stub).
- Vendor paperwork: we can accept their PO template; procurement should also send a completed vendor form and W-9.

Action items
1) Alex — send the attached onboarding checklist and the final MSA (I’ll prepare a clean copy for signature).
2) Sofia / procurement team — please return your completed PO (with number) and vendor form when ready; include the W-9.
3) I’ll upload SOC 2 and the onboarding checklist to the DocuSign Hub and share the link.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 34 KB)
